verdicts.reason: A is the better resize. Its two-line headline is large and the 'Try It' button stands out. Its flaws: the left-aligned headline and the right-aligned NEW/Try It buttons don't share an edge, the bottom-left is empty, the two buttons are different widths, the bottle sits small and crowded into the top-left corner, and a cut-off ghost circle shows at the edge. B looks like the banner spread across a square. The bottle is tiny in the corner, the centered one-line headline sits alone in the middle, and the small NEW and Try It buttons are pushed to the right edge with big empty gaps between them. It mixes three alignments (left, center, right), the hierarchy is weak and the layout doesn't hold together.
